channel.title: Software Factory News
channel.description: A private daily briefing for Andrew Rux on how teams build software factories: agents, CI/CD, gates, and lessons learned.

item.title: Wed 11 Nov 2026: Toward the idea-to-deploy factory
item.description: Oliver and Sophie walk through six stories (AWS Bedrock AgentCore remote Claude Code sessions, Cursor multiplayer Projects, Van Duc Nguyen's agent-fleet gates, Google's Agent Distraction study, GitHub Agentic Workflows GA, and CNCF on platform engineering) through the lens of a self-improving, idea-to-deploy software factory, then a deep dive on the autonomous CI/CD stack with examples from StrongDM, Vercel, Chipp and AWS ABCA.
